0:
Father.
We are heading for Tora.
Dain is a good fellow.
But we can't tell him everything.
We'll take him to Tora,
and he can wait for us there.
3: Do you know anyone in Tora?
5: You've come looking for your real parents. Haven't you?
7: King Endon and Queen Sharn might be here.
8: It wouldn't be strange if they were in Tora.
14: It's just a goat, isn't it?
17: Dain, that's the second time you've saved our lives.
18: Yes, we'd never have noticed on our own.
19: It was just luck. I'm a cautious person.
24: All right! Leave the Ols to me!
26:
What's this feeling?
As if someone had stolen my friends…
27: Lief, what are you doing? We'll leave you behind!
32: Say, Lief. This city… Hey, Lief, what's wrong?
34: Leave those two be. Dain's safe with Jasmine.
35: …Yes. Say, Barda. Do you think King Endon's here?
36: …It seems unlikely. Have you noticed something's wrong with this city? There's no sign of anyone at all. It doesn't look like the Shadow Lord's work. Tora should be protected by powerful magic… Perhaps that magic made the people vanish.
39: No one's here. My father and mother aren't here…
40: Dain… I know it's hard, but keep your spirits up.
41: That's right, Dain. They must be somewhere else.
42: Jasmine, Barda, Lief. Thank you. Sorry you had to see me like that… But Jasmine's right. If they're alive, I'll meet them some day.
43: Hmph. I knew this would happen.
45: This city has been empty a long time. Sixteen years or so, I'd say. It stays beautiful because of its magic. That same magic made its people vanish…
47: Long, long ago… the people of Tora swore an eternal oath. An oath of loyalty to the royal house of Deltora. In return, they received magic that promised safety and plenty.
49: Yes. When King Endon of Deltora asked them for help…
50: Then my father did come here?
51: In person or by letter, I don't know… Either way, the people of Tora broke their oath. It was sworn long ago. People's hearts change… No, I sympathise with the people of Tora. This world fell to the Shadow Lord and became a world of fear… Because King Endon was such a fool. When that king begged for help, why would anyone welcome him?
52: Don't speak ill of my father!
53: You, King Endon's son? I don't believe such nonsense. For you have wisdom and courage. Neither runs in the royal blood. What do you say, Dain? Will you come back to the Resistance?
57: Thank you, everyone, for all you've done. I can't get in the way of your journey any more. It was my dream to come here and find my parents. But it seems that can't happen yet. So I'll fight to save people from the Shadow Lord. I can look for my parents after that. I'm going back to the Resistance. From now on, I'll follow Doom.
62: We saw the real Doom's grave, didn't we?
63: This man is a fake Doom. He may even serve the Shadow Lord!
66: Well, there's no need to hide it. I was forced to fight monsters in the Shadowlands arena. A cruel spectacle. I escaped and made it back to Deltora.
67: So you did come from the Shadowlands!
68: No… I have a few memories of my days in Deltora.
70: After I escaped, hunters surrounded me and nearly killed me. That's probably when I lost most of my memories. All I remember… is the name of the kind man who sheltered and cared for me. Doom. I took his name in gratitude.
72: You needn't believe me. The Resistance trusts me. That trust is all I need to keep fighting.
73: I'll give you this hat. The Shadow Lord's servants are looking for your hair. Hide it, and you'll look just like a boy.
75: I think it suits you, Jasmine.
76: …I suppose I have no choice. It's for my safety…
79: Dain, we'll meet again, won't we!
80: Of course, Jasmine! Barda, Lief. Take care!
82: It's not goodbye forever, is it? Now, let's put this behind us. Let's go and get the last gem back!
85: The Valley of the Lost… Ready?
89: They don't seem to be enemies. Let's think about it once we have the gem.
91: No, that's how we'll save them.
92: Yes, that's right. There must be a guardian protecting the gem. And around the guardian there are people suffering. It's always been that way.
94: Gathering the gems is how we save the world. I have no more doubts.
97: The gems or you two. Asked which matters more, I'd say Lief and Jasmine. But neither of you needs me to worry any more.
101: So I have no more doubts.
104: Yes, it's warm. The gem is here. The seventh gem, the diamond!
105:
The diamond, symbol of innocence
and strength, charms all hearts.
The pure who hold it gain courage,
escape misfortune and find true love.
106:
But beware. The diamond hates
violence and injustice.

Whoever seizes it through greed
will surely meet with misfortune.
109: I am Endon. I guard these beautiful gems by order of one above me.
111: King… I was called that, once. Betrayed by my advisers, I fled the palace and wandered. After much hardship I reached this valley and met the Shadow Lord. He gave me beautiful treasure and many subjects. Have you seen the dead who roam the valley? They all welcome you.
112: You are King Endon? I can't believe it…
113: That's right! The king isn't such an old man.
114: A life of hardship ages one quickly. That is all…
115: Say, what about the heir? The king must have a child.
117: I don't believe it! You're not King Endon!
118: More to the point, you came for the gem, did you not? Then shall we play a game? If you want the gem, you must take part in a game. That is the rule of this valley.
120: (Lief, we don't have to go along with this.)
121: (That's right… If the three of us work together…)
122: (Yes… N-no, we can't! The diamond hates injustice.) (If there are rules, we have to follow them.)
123: Hmm… What sort of game is it?
124: A game that suits you. I shall read your hearts and decide. Win, and the gem is yours. Lose, and don't worry. You can live in this valley forever.
127: No. But we have no choice.
128: It seems you've decided. Then I shall prepare the game with magic. Here we go!
133: Oho… From now on, one at a time. First… you!
135: Heh heh heh… I can read your heart like a book… What suits you best is… this!
137: (No, this is an illusion made by magic.)
140: Hey, you! If you don't want to get hurt, run!
142: Come on, Jasmine, let's go. With my Belt, I don't fear the Shadow Lord!
144: (What is this… It's an illusion, but it makes me so mad.)
147: Hey, you're in the way. You'll get hurt!
149: Well, Dain. The quest is almost over. The gems you gathered at the risk of your life… You must show them to your father first.
151: I wonder if Dain's father will like me?
152: You? I'm sure he will, Jasmine.
154: Father, Mother! I've got all the gems! I did it!
156: We had a dream. That our son wasn't Dain, but someone called Lief… A dream that some useless boy was our son.
159: You there! Don't just stand there gawping, give me a hand!
160: That boy's terrified. Don't drag him into it…
161: It's dangerous, lad. Get inside and hide.
162: That's right, our Dain is strong. Leave it to him.
163: What an illusion to show me!
164: Oho… You overcame it. Now you. Jasmine, wasn't it?
165: It's all right, Jasmine. Be strong!
166: Heh heh heh… What suits you best is…
167: Something's written here… Offer up 3 {fff8}Pitch-Black Stones{fffc}…
169: I've collected 3 {fff8}Pitch-Black Stones{fffc}. I'll put them here.
170: Hmph. Find the {fff8}Phantom Necklace{fffc} and I'll let you through!
173: Something's written here… Do not move. Calm your heart…
180: This is a game? Don't mock me!
184: Now, Guardian. We have finished your game!
185: Give us the gem. Those are the rules, aren't they?
186: N-no, I won't. This gem is my treasure! Without it, I…
187: The diamond hates injustice. If you don't hand it over, its power will…
193:
{fff9}Father.
{fff9}We've finally done it.
{fff9}All seven places on the Belt
{fff9}are filled!
198: I am Zeean of the Torans. How can we ever thank you…
199: Zeean. The people of Tora broke their oath. Was this the result?
200: Yes, to our shame. Tora prospered because of its magic. And yet we… We came to think we were perfect. So when a letter came from King Endon asking for help… we paid no heed to our ancient oath. But the oath was still alive.
202: I'm sorry to say we know nothing…
203: Thanks to you, my eyes are open…
204: You're not King Endon, are you?
205: No. I am not. I ran an inn in a town called Rithmere.
207: You know it. I was its owner. Then Grey Guards suddenly attacked the inn… I barely escaped to this land with my life. And I lived on in anger and despair.
208: And the Shadow Lord took advantage of that?
210: But why call yourself King Endon?
211: On the Shadow Lord's orders. If people saw and heard me…
212: I see! No one would want to fight for the king!
213: Exactly. Only one person ever won the game. He refused to take the gem… He only said he'd lost faith in the king, and left…
215: A man called Doom, I believe.
218: I am truly sorry for what I've done…
220: It's all thanks to you and Barda.
221: I'm sorry for all the nasty things I said.
223: Oh. I should have been nastier.
226: You're right. If I want to tease someone, it's Barda.
228: Say, Lief. Show me the Belt once more.
230: …No, actually, I want to see it too.
235: Ha ha ha ha ha ha! We did it!
236:
Father.
I haven't laughed like this in ages.
We still have to find the royal heir,
but I'm not too worried.
237:
We have a guide.

I feel sure this Belt of Deltora
will show us the way.
238: Thank you for saving us! Hee hee… I can't stop smiling!
239: I'm ashamed we broke our oath to the king. Promises must be kept!
240: I can walk with my feet on the ground! That's so important!
241: Wandering the valley, I hardly felt alive. Thank you so much!
242: Thank you… Our gratitude to you is beyond words.
244: From now on, I'll atone for my crimes by helping others…
245: There, there. Let's leave the hard talk to Lief and Barda, Kree.
246: It's thanks to you that we can live in this city again. Thank you so much.
247: Our arrogance brought suffering on the king and the world… We must find a way to atone…
248: It's like a dream to be with my family again!
249: Thank you! Thank you so much!
251: We lived here with our troubles… But it beats wandering that valley as the dead!
252: Tora will be reborn. As a city that never forgets to be grateful for each day.
253: Life starts now! I'll do my best!
254: Thank you, Lief. I'll never forget you.
255: Tora will never break its oath again!
